_comment: Cards for tests/unit/combat/test_cant_attack_planeswalkers_filtered.py. `t_jace_walker` is a vanilla Jace for the restriction to protect, beside testing.cards.json's `t_walker` (a Sorin) that it must not. `t_jace_gate` is Jace, Multiverse Architect's first line on an artifact, so the trigger can be tested without the walker's own loyalty abilities in the way.

cards.name: Test Jace Gate
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn, they may pay {2}. If they don't, creatures they control can't attack Jaces you control this turn.

abilities.text: At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn, they may pay {2}. If they don't, creatures they control can't attack Jaces you control this turn.
